παρακειμαι.def: I am at hand, am present with, rest with.

προσηλυτοσ.def: (lit: that has come to), a proselyte, that is a non-Jew, who has been circumcised and has adopted the Jews' religion.

προσκαρτερεω.def: I persist, persevere in, continue steadfast in; I wait upon.

προσκληροω.def: I assign by lot, allot, associate with, follow as a disciple.

προσκολλαω.def: (lit: I glue one thing to another), I join (unite) closely, cleave (to), follow as an adherent.

προσκομμα.def: a stumbling-block, an occasion for falling, a moral embarrassment.

προσκοπη.def: a cause of stumbling, offense, shock.

προσκοπτω.def: I stumble, strike the foot against, beat upon, take offense at.

προσκυλιω.def: I roll to, roll up against.

προσκυνεω.def: I go down on my knees to, do obeisance to, worship.

προσλαμβανω.def: (a) I take to myself, (b) I take aside, (c) I welcome.

προσληψισ.def: a receiving, a taking to one's self, acceptance.

προσμενω.def: I remain; I abide in, remain in, persist in, adhere to.

προσοχθιζω.def: I am displeased or offended with.

προσπηγνυμι.def: I fasten to, applied to Christ's being fastened to the cross.

προσπιπτω.gloss: I fall down before, beat against
προσπιπτω.def: (a) I fall down before, (b) I beat against, rush violently upon.

προσποιεω.def: I pretend, regard, make a show of.

προστασσω.def: (a) I instruct, command, (b) I appoint, assign.

προστιθημι.gloss: I put to, add, do again
προστιθημι.def: I place (put) to, add; I do again.

προσφαγιον.def: anything eaten with bread, especially fish or meat.

προσφατοσ.def: (originally: newly slaughtered, freshly killed), recent, new.

προσφερω.def: (a) I bring to, (b) characteristically: I offer (of gifts, sacrifices, etc).

προσφωνεω.def: I call to, summon; I call (out) to, address, give a speech to, harangue.

προσχυσισ.def: a pouring upon, an effusion, a sprinkling.

προτεινω.def: I stretch out, tie up (for scourging), extend before.

προτρεχω.def: I run before, outrun, run in advance.

προυπαρχω.def: I have been already, have been previously.

προφητεια.def: prophecy, prophesying; the gift of communicating and enforcing revealed truth.

προφητευω.def: I foretell, prophesy; I set forth matter of divine teaching by special faculty.

προφητησ.def: a prophet, poet; a person gifted at expositing divine truth.

προχειριζομαι.def: I appoint, choose, elect, take into hand.

προχοροσ.def: Prochorus, one of the seven original deacons at Jerusalem.

πρωι.gloss: early in the morning, at dawn
πρωι.def: early in the morning, at dawn.

πρωτευω.def: I have preeminence, am chief, am first.

πρωτοκλισια.gloss: the chief place at a banquet
πρωτοκλισια.def: the chief place at a banquet or table.

πρωτον.def: first, in the first place, before, formerly.

πρωτοστατησ.def: one who stands in the front rank, hence: a leader, ringleader, chief.

πρωτοτοκια.def: the birthright, the rights of the first-born.

πταιω.def: I stumble, fall, sin, err, transgress.

πτοεω.def: I terrify, scare, strike with panic.

πτολεμαισ.def: Ptolemais, a coast city of Phoenicia, midway between Tyre and Caesarea.

πτυον.def: a simple wooden pitchfork; a winnowing-shovel or fan.

πτυσσω.def: I fold, roll up (as a scroll).

πτωμα.def: a fall; a carcass, corpse, dead body.

πτωχευω.def: I am in poverty, am a beggar.

πτωχοσ.def: poor, destitute, spiritually poor, either in a good sense (humble devout persons) or bad.

πυθων.def: a divining spirit, Python, called after the Pythian serpent said to have guarded the oracle at Delphi and been slain by Apollo.

πυλων.gloss: a large gate, a gateway, porch
πυλων.def: a large gate; a gateway, porch, vestibule.

πυνθανομαι.def: I ask, inquire, ascertain by inquiry, understand.

πυρ.def: fire; the heat of the sun, lightning; fig: strife, trials; the eternal fire.

πυρα.def: a fire, pile of burning fuel.

πυρεσσω.gloss: I am sick with a fever
πυρεσσω.def: I am sick with a fever.

πυροω.gloss: I burn, am purified by fire
πυροω.def: pass: I burn, am set on fire, am inflamed; glow with heat, am purified by fire.

πωσ.def: how, in what manner, by what means.
